record.context_brief: Local rigidity for split Cartan subgroup actions
record.original_question: Let G be a connected semisimple Lie group, Γ an irreducible lattice in G, and A a closed subgroup of a split Cartan subgroup of G with dim A > 1. Is every C^1-small perturbation of the action of A on G/Γ C^∞-conjugate to an action of A defined by a continuous homomorphism from A to the centralizer of A in G?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 1. Let G be a connected semisimple Lie group, Γ an irreducible lattice in G, and A a closed subgroup of a split Cartan subgroup of G with dim A > 1. Then any C 1-small perturbation of the action of A on G /Γ is C ∞ -conjugate to the action of A deﬁned by a continuous homomorphism from A to the c entralizer of A in G.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $G$ be a connected semisimple Lie group, let $\Gamma$ be an irreducible lattice in $G$, and let $A$ be a closed subgroup of a split Cartan subgroup of $G$ with $\dim A > 1$. The group $A$ acts on the homogeneous space $G/\Gamma$ by left translations. Decide whether the following statement holds: every $C^1$-small perturbation of this $A$-action on $G/\Gamma$ is $C^\infty$-conjugate to an $A$-action of the form $a \cdot x\Gamma = \rho(a)\, x\Gamma$, where $\rho \colon A \to Z_G(A)$ is a continuous homomorphism into the centralizer of $A$ in $G$.
artifact.category_tag: Local rigidity of higher-rank abelian actions
artifact.status_search_result: This is a form of the Katok–Spatzier local rigidity conjecture for higher-rank abelian (split Cartan) actions on homogeneous spaces. The full conjecture remains open in general. Significant partial results are known: local (and global) rigidity has been established for the full split Cartan action (Katok–Spatzier; Goetze–Spatzier; Damjanović–Katok and subsequent work), for various Anosov/genuinely higher-rank cases, and for actions not contained in a Weyl chamber wall. No source verifies a complete proof of the conjecture as stated.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields (Gorodnik)
status_evidence.snippet: CONJECTURE 1. ... any C^1-small perturbation of the action of A on G/Γ is C^∞-conjugate to the action of A defined by a continuous homomorphism from A to the centralizer of A in G.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is stated and the closely related Conjecture 2 is noted as proved only when A is the full split Cartan subgroup, indicating partial progress.

status_evidence.title: An invitation to rigidity theory (R. J. Spatzier)
status_evidence.snippet: Katok and Spatzier proved local rigidity of higher rank actions in various settings; full local rigidity for general subgroups of Cartan remains an active conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Survey indicates substantial partial results but the general split Cartan local rigidity conjecture remains an open program.

status_evidence.title: On the Classification of Cartan Actions (Kalinin–Spatzier)
status_evidence.snippet: Classification and rigidity results for Cartan actions on homogeneous spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Demonstrates partial resolution in the full Cartan case.
